notes: Institutional memory of the Edge Agent. Every concept ever tested with its verdict. Never re-test a concept present here without a fundamentally new data source. Evidence files under backtest/edge_lab/ and backtest/results/.

edges.concept: Liquidity sweep detection (stop-hunt reversal AND breakout continuation) as a directional entry signal
edges.notes: Sweep events systematically UNDERPERFORM same-direction random entries by 0.05-0.2 ATR. Only nominally-significant positives were overlapping-event artifacts (failed non-overlap test). Sweep timing systematically misses underlying drift.

edges.concept: Tick-volume flow scoring (volume z-score quintiles, spikes z>1/z>2, strong-close bars in top 10% range) predicting continuation or exhaustion
edges.verdict: NO EDGE (XAUUSD M15 strong-close MARGINAL -> under evaluation)
edges.notes: No monotone/exploitable structure anywhere. XAUUSD M15 strong-close showed gross +0.14-0.18 ATR (cost 0.018 ATR) but collapsed in 2nd half and no cross-market replication. Promoted to paper monitor only.

edges.concept: CFTC COT money-manager positioning extremes (percentile fade) and weekly delta continuation as FX bias filter
edges.notes: No bucket differs from baseline (Welch t + 10k bootstrap CI include 0). Legacy cross-check confirms flatness except EUR where fade LOSES (2005-2015 artifact, recent half N=15).

edges.concept: Cross-asset lead-lag ('follow the money'): DXY->EUR/GBP, Oil->USDJPY, NDX->XAU/USDJPY, EURUSD->GBPUSD
edges.symbols_tfs: H1 (884 bars), M15, H4 (7.5 months), D1 (2.7y), London/NY session gates
edges.n_events: 432 cells first pass; 1014 cells total incl. H4/D1/sessions
edges.notes: Leader info is already priced into the follower's own past bar. DXY apparent lead is mechanical self-contamination (EURUSD 52.6% of basket). Session gating made it worse. Zero cells beat own-momentum baseline even at p<0.10.

edges.concept: XAUUSD M15 strong-close continuation (top-10% range close + volume z>1) - paper trade monitor
edges.notes: Warmup 20 events (in-sample overlap) showed 55% WR / +0.48 ATR drift3 - NOT evidence. Only events from 2026-08-17 onward count. Daily scheduled task 'XAU Paper Monitor' runs at 18:00. Promote only if out-of-sample stays positive.
